verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents filtering vector search on metadata fields via `where(...)` conditions. Its pre-filtering mode applies the condition before the vector search, so only matching rows are considered, which directly addresses the recall concern. A community comment also notes predicate pushdown for filters. missing for 10: evidence on filtered-search latency (e.g., scalar indexes on metadata columns or benchmarks), detail on supported filter expression syntax, and independent hands-on corroboration that recall holds under selective filters.
